gloss: to be injured; to be wounded

definitions.gloss: to be injured; to be wounded
definitions.explanation: To suffer a physical injury, especially in an accident, disaster, or conflict. A formal word common in news reports.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{負傷|ふしょう}する。
examples.english: To be injured in an accident.

examples.japanese: その{選手|せんしゅ}は{試合中|しあいちゅう}に{負傷|ふしょう}した。
examples.english: The player was injured during the match.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{負傷|ふしょう}し、{病院|びょういん}に{運|はこ}ばれた。
examples.english: Many people were injured in the earthquake and taken to the hospital.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive suru verb. Xが{負傷|ふしょう}する. The noun {負傷|ふしょう} also stands alone.

Formal; common in news reports. Everyday speech uses けがをする.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故|じこ}で{負傷|ふしょう}する: to be injured in an accident
- {負傷者|ふしょうしゃ}: an injured person; casualty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- けがをする: to get hurt — everyday and neutral
- {重傷|じゅうしょう}を{負|お}う: to be seriously injured
